WebAssembly
My hobby project is to port computer algebra systems to WebAssembly. WebAssembly is a target of compilers that allows running high level language code in browsers at near-native speed. This work could be beneficial for purposes including education, scientific demo, interactive presentations, and reproducible numerical experiments.

title: \(\mathrm{Out}(F_n)\)
text:
Motivation
There is a natural map \(\mathrm{Out}(F_n) \to \mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{Z})\) given by abelianization. This map is onto. And in special case when \(n = 2\), this map becomes isomorphism.
Finding the structure of \(\mathrm{Out}(F_n)\) and \(\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)\) may simplify some group theoretic calculations.
